AI Agent vs AI Model: What's Actually the Difference? The model is just weights, a huge file of numbers. Your prompt becomes tokens, those tokens run through the numbers, and text comes back. That's all it does. It can't click, run a script, or check whether its own answer actually worked. The agent is what changes that. It wraps the model, gives it real tools, and runs whatever the model asks for, then hands the output straight back. Fixing one bug can take twenty of these calls before the code works, and the model never touches your machine. Claude Opus does the thinking. Claude Code does the doing. The thinking was there the whole time. What the model needed was a way to act on it. Wrap it in an agent and the brain finally gets a body. #AIAgents #AIModel #ArtificialIntelligence #ClaudeCode #MachineLearning #SoftwareEngineering #LLM #DevOps #AITools #CodingAgents #TechExplained
